mermaid:
stateDiagram-v2
    state "Requested" as S1
    state "Accepted by the location" as S2
    state "In progress" as S3
    state "Shipped" as S4
    state "Delivered" as S5
    state "Incomplete, short pick" as S6
    state "Canceled" as S7
    S1 --> S2: location accepts
    S1 --> S7: location rejects or merchant cancels
    S2 --> S3: pick released
    S3 --> S4: shipment confirmed
    S4 --> S5: carrier delivery scan
    S3 --> S6: short pick reported
    S6 --> S1: re-routed as a new fulfillment order
    S2 --> S7: cancellation request accepted

flowchart LR
    O["Order with three lines"] --> R["Routing rules"]
    AV["Available per location"] --> R
    CAP["Capacity and cut-off per location"] --> R
    COST["Carrier cost and split limits"] --> R
    R -->|"lines 1 and 2"| F1["Fulfillment order, Duiven"]
    R -->|"line 3"| F2["Fulfillment order, Utrecht store"]
    R -.->|"or"| HOLD["Wait for replenishment, one parcel"]

sequenceDiagram
    participant PL as the platform
    participant OMS as the OMS
    participant AV as Availability module
    participant WMS as the WMS
    participant PN as PostNL
    participant ERP as the ERP
    PL->>OMS: Order placed 1072455, jacket and socks, paid
    OMS->>AV: Commit one jacket and two socks at Duiven
    OMS->>WMS: Fulfillment order 1072455-1, request
    WMS-->>OMS: Accepted
    WMS-->>OMS: Shipped, tracking number
    OMS-->>PL: Goods state shipped, one parcel of one
    PN-->>OMS: Delivered
    OMS-->>PL: Goods state delivered
    OMS->>ERP: Shipment to invoice, idempotent on shipment id
